description: Source code for the CreateBundleTargetGenerator class, which generates build targets for bundles in a build system, including setting directories, product types, scripts, and other bundle-related configurations.

classes.name: CreateBundleTargetGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating build targets for bundles, configuring directories, product types, scripts, and other bundle attributes.

methods.name: CreateBundleTargetGenerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the generator with target, scope, function call, and error object.

methods.name: DoRun
methods.description: Main method executing the target generation process, setting output type and filling various bundle attributes.

methods.name: FillBundleDir
methods.description: Sets a directory property for the bundle, ensuring it is within the bundle root directory.

methods.name: FillXcodeExtraAttributes
methods.description: Populates extra Xcode attributes from scope into the target's bundle data.

methods.name: FillProductType
methods.description: Sets the product type for the bundle.

methods.name: FillPartialInfoPlist
methods.description: Sets the partial Info.plist file for the bundle.

methods.name: FillXcodeTestApplicationName
methods.description: Sets the Xcode test application name.

methods.name: FillPostProcessingSources
methods.description: Sets the list of post-processing source files.

methods.name: FillPostProcessingOutputs
methods.description: Sets the list of post-processing output files.

methods.name: FillBundleDepsFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter for bundle dependencies.

methods.name: FillTransparent
methods.description: Sets whether the bundle is transparent.
